data.body: Progress: plan review certified (after one BLOCK: the first draft wrote the checkpoint with SNAPSHOT overrides, read SHAs only at stream end, and diffed against the original first parent; revised to mark :1 checkpoint / :2 ledger anchor, get-mark over --cat-blob-fd mid-stream, and source_of-based diff base). Claimed. Implemented on branch s1-stream-collapse, commit 0f980b65fa0: new src/rebar/_commands/reclaim_collapse_stream.py (FastImportSession, ObjectReader), _StreamedRewrite in reclaim_collapse.py. In-stream parents are referenced by mark because fast-import cannot resolve its own not-yet-packed commits by SHA. Tests: the 10 existing collapse tests pass unchanged; new oracle test (side branch forked below and merged above the boundary, deletion, same-commit event+SNAPSHOT, retired SNAPSHOT) passes on BOTH this engine and the previous per-commit engine; cost test shows one fast-import and one cat-file --batch; failure test leaves the branch unchanged. lint, typecheck, C901 green. Real-scale timing probe running on a TMPDIR shadow fetched from origin/tickets T0 85e68dbabe4 (13,149 commits above a 30-day boundary a1f5c33f941, 897 merges).
